### Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes – October 14, 2025

#### Season 19 – Haunted Masquerade

Unmask Your Power. Haunt the Competition. Season 19 creeps in... ambitious and cloaked in mystery! The Haunted Masquerade event introduces a spooktacular mode where mystical masks grant buffs, twisting every battle into a spectral spectacle. Plus, something wicked this way returns as Junkenstein's Revenge and Wrath of the Bride are back for frightful co-op fights. Then Stadium transforms under the eerie moonlight, unveiling new Heroes, a cursed map, fresh features, and match-defining Gadgets forged in shadow. Across the season, the festive spirit of Halloween stretches wide as Mythic cosmetics rise from the crypt, and a treasure trove of twisted tricks & treats awaits those brave enough to claim them. Welcome to the Haunted Masquerade, ENTER IF YOU DARE!

#### New Arcade Game Mode – Haunted Masquerade

It's spooky time! The Haunted Masquerade is Season 19’s costumed centerpiece. Teams wear the mystical masks of currently allied Heroes, each granting buffs that can flip the fight for friends or foes and force fun new compositions. Everyone acquires special abilities based on whose mask they wear, with some granting specific benefits to lore linked Heroes and all of them rewarding synergy at every turn. Enter the Haunted Masquerade… IF YOU DARE!

#### Halloween Terror Returns

Your favorite Spooky modes return as Halloween Terror 2025 brings new tricks and returning treats to Overwatch 2. Join forces in this returning fan favorite 4-player co-op mode to defend Adlersbrunn from Dr. Junkenstein and his monstrous creations. Battle hordes of zombie Omnics and powerful bosses in a quest to save the castle from certain doom. Then, continue the story from Junkenstein's Revenge, featuring four heroes—Sojourn, Junker Queen, Kiriko, and Ashe—who must break down barricades, fight off exploding zombie omnics, and defeat powerful enemies like Banshee Moira and Gargoyle Winston to uncover the dark secrets of Adlersbrunn. Navigate through haunted castles, solve puzzles, and face terrifying jump scares as you progress through this atmospheric and gripping co-op adventure.

#### General Updates

Hero Mastery Mode

* The Hero Mastery mode and courses are no longer available to play.

Developer comments: As we focus more time and effort into delivering the best experience for Quick Play, Competitive, Stadium, and other new ways to play, we’re going to be shifting focus away from past game modes that haven’t seen as much attention. With this in mind, we’ve made the decision to sunset Hero Mastery courses.

Team Text Chat

* New Options added to Social → Text Chat
* The color of each existing Text Chat Channel (Whisper/Group/Team/Match) can now be set. These default to their existing colors.
* The color Comms/Pings can now be set.
* Tabbing through each of the potential text chat channels includes a small new visual element to indicate that the channel has changed.

#### Stadium Updates

Stadium Competitive Updates

* Stadium Competitive will now use the best of 5 format.
* Powers are granted on rounds 1, 2, 3 and 5
* The first team that wins 3 rounds will win the match
* The mercy rule has been disabled
* Round 1 completion cash increased to 7500 (Up from 5000)
* Round 2 completion cash increased to 5000 (Up from 4000)
* Round complete cash increased to 4250 (Up from 3500)
* The amount of cash generated each round from healing and damage has been increased
* MVP bonus increased to 1500 (Up from 1000)

Developer comments: Now that stadium has been out for three seasons, players have a better understanding of the mode and how it works. Based on this, we think we can move away from the more segmented power curve offered by the 7-round approach, which served us well in these early months. We have been happy with the results of the Quick Play format in Season 18 and we want to bring those same wins to competitive. The goal of this change is to keep the competitive nature of the format while still making it move at a faster pace. We look forward to your feedback on this as we continue to iterate on Stadium and make it the best it can be.

#### Introducing... Gadgets!

Developer comments: We're continuing our goal of improving our General Item selection to give you the agency you need to address more matchups and further customize your playstyle. We're introducing Gadgets, which are Active Items that grant you a bonus ability with a cooldown when you purchase them. Gadgets appear in the HUD, near your existing abilities. They can be activated with a customizable hotkey and you can have one equipped at a time.

* Your control bindings for certain inputs may have been changed to accommodate for the new "Use Gadget" input.
* For keyboard inputs, Gadget activation is by default bound to the 3 key.
* For controller inputs, Gadget activation is by default bound to the Directional Pad Up Key.

##### 安娜

开发者评论：安娜的技能强度构建并没有发挥作用，与其他选项相比，尤其是在游戏中后期，往往感觉效果不佳。我们重新设计了它，使她更具影响力，并确保对于那些想要专注于技能强度玩法的玩家来说，该构建是一条可行的道路。

艺术飞镖 - 强化

*   新强化。
*   使用生物步枪开镜时，安娜可以通过生物步枪发射睡眠镖，弹道速度增加150%。

抚慰之泉 - 强化

*   新强化。
*   睡眠镖在撞击时生成一个具有50%治疗、伤害和持续时间的生物手雷。

剧毒 - 强化

*   伤害降低至60（原为75）。

*   从强化更改为稀有武器英雄物品。

镇定剂 – 史诗技能英雄物品

双倍剂量 – 史诗技能英雄物品

##### 布丽吉塔

开发者评论：布丽吉塔的武器强度构建一直在努力寻找立足点。我们正在增加这些强化的可用性，以帮助使以武器强度为中心的构建成为更可行的选择。

*   输入更改为重新装填（原为近战攻击）。
*   每个消耗的恢复包的最大生命值治疗量增加至25%（原为20%）。
*   每个消耗的恢复包的攻击速度增益增加至10%（原为5%）。

正义挥击 - 强化

*   治疗现在在下一次造成伤害的火箭连枷挥舞时触发（更改自下一次火箭连枷挥舞）。

![卢西奥](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/dAcf/256X256/dee7e92975f5e659fa6b28c508d8fbad62bda720698b1d21f2492af7b9f94b48-t.png)

弹跳起来 - 强化

爬墙律动 - 强化

*   每1秒获得的最大生命值超量生命值增加至4%（原为3%）。

角斗领域

### 《守望先锋》补丁说明——2025年10月15日

#### 第19赛季——鬼魅假面舞会

揭开面具，展现强大实力；化身鬼魅，将对手死死缠住。第19赛季阴森开战……诡异氛围，充实内容，还有神秘惊喜在“瞪”着你！鬼魅假面舞会活动会带来“惊”彩纷呈的模式，拥有神秘力量的面具会为你提供增益，让每场战斗都变成华丽鬼魅的盛宴。此外，怪鼠复仇和新娘之怒惊悚回归，带你体验恐怖的合作战斗，让大家再次接受邪恶力量的洗礼。另外，角斗领域也在怪诞的月光下发生变异——新的英雄身影浮现，新地图开始散播诅咒，全新内容开启精彩，以及在幽影中铸造、能够让比赛焕然一新的装置。在整个赛季过程中，多款神话个性化物品将从坟墓中爬出，带你体验万圣节的节日氛围，还有更多令人毛骨悚然的糖果礼物在等着勇敢的人去夺取。欢迎加入这场万圣节鬼魅假面舞会，够胆你就来！

#### 全新游戏模式街机——鬼魅假面舞会

享受惊悚恐怖！在第19赛季，盛装上演的鬼魅假面舞会将会是所有人关注的焦点！双方队伍可以戴上神秘的面具，扮演友方英雄，并获得相应的能力，通过奇妙的新组合颠覆战局，助力队友、痛扁敌人。每个人都可以根据戴上的面具所代表的角色而获得特殊技能，而在背景设定上有所关联的英雄之间还能产生威力巨大的协同效果，提供特殊的增益。快来参加鬼魅假面舞会吧……够胆你就来！
